official.summary: High Peak 58 temporary timetable 25 July to 30 October 2026

The closure will affect the A54 Macclesfield Road which will prevent the service from accessing the Cat & Fiddle to last between 25 July and 30 October 2026.

To maintain a service between Buxton and Macclesfield the bus will divert via Long Hill, Kettleshulme and Rainow with most journeys continuing beyond Macclesfield Bus Station to maintain a service to the Black Road area. 

Due to the length of this diversion it is not possible for the 58 to maintain service provision to the Burbage area of Buxton during the period of the road closure.

official.summary: Road Closure - Wessex Lane/Wide Lane Junction, Southampton
official.description: Due to roadworks, the Wessex Lane/Wide Lane junction will be closed n both directions from Monday 26th October until Wednesday 4th November.
official.advice:
Due to roadworks, the Wessex Lane/Wide Lane junction will be closed n both directions from Monday 26th October until Wednesday 4th November. Services towards Southampton Airport will operate their normal route as far as Burgess Road and will then divert via Stoneham Way until the M27 J5 roundabout where they will take the 3rd exit for Eastleigh & Airport. The U1E will then divert onto Southampton Road to its normal route. The U1A will divert onto Wide Lane and then Mitchell Way  to continue to normal route. The U1N will divert via Burgess Road, High Road and Langhorn Road to continue to normal route. 

Services towards the university will operate their normal route as far as Mitchell Way and then divert via Wide Lane, Stoneham Way, High Road  and Langhorn Road to continue to normal route.
